locations.note: The campaign opens with Able Company storming Omaha Beach on D-Day.
Fox Company's paratroopers seize Carentan and hold it against a German counterattack.
Able Company defends the Red Ball Express convoys at Montebourg from the Panzer Lehr and its Tiger ace, Hauptmann Shultz.
Capturing the port of Cherbourg is the first major objective after the beachhead.
Able Company fights for Hill 192 and Saint-Lô, the hinge of the Allied breakout from the bocage.
Under the newly promoted Lieutenant Conti, Able Company holds Hill 317 outside Mortain against a German armoured counter-attack, then retakes the town.
Able Company links up with Canadian and Polish forces at Chambois and crushes the German escape from the Falaise pocket, ending the Normandy campaign.

routes.name: Able Company
routes.note: Able Company lands on Omaha Beach, relieves the paratroopers at Carentan, guards the Red Ball Express at Montebourg, takes Cherbourg's harbour, breaks out at Saint-Lô, holds Hill 317 at Mortain and ends by closing the Falaise pocket at Chambois.
